Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, EIGHT consecutive frames of a NEUTRAL WALK LOOP.
Input image1 is our approved painted knight, IDENTITY/COSTUME reference. Image2 is the same knight's approved combat pose for identity confirmation only; this action is NEUTRAL walking.
Output a clean 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid, EXACTLY8 full-body drawings, chronological left-to-right top row then bottom row. Large landscape canvas about2048x1536 or1536x1024. Every cell has equal size, transparent padding, a fixed shared bottom-center ground anchor and SAME CAMERA/SCALE. No drawn grid lines or labels.
Single subject repeated across the eight cells: exact same adult dark-haired exposed-face knight, navy split tabard, blue-steel breastplate with modest brass trim, segmented pauldrons, chainmail joints, diagonal brown strap, brown leather/steel GLOVES, proportional slim brown boots. Same face/hair, costume, proportions, lighting and colors in all frames. Full body in3/4 view facing SCREEN RIGHT, shallow18-degree downward tactical camera.
NEUTRAL WALK, weapon sheathed in a simple brown scabbard at far hip, hands free with modest opposite arm swing, not combat gripping. A natural restrained human gait with legs tracking forward beneath hips, not wide straddling, no bowed knees, no crouch, no giant boots, no hopping. Clean pose mechanics:
Frame1 left-foot forward heel-contact, right foot back at toe-off.
Frame2 weight goes onto left sole, right heel lifts and right knee begins swing.
Frame3 left leg supports upright body; right knee passes forward, right toe lifted.
Frame4 right lower leg reaches forward for its heel contact, left heel begins lift.
Frame5 right foot forward heel-contact, left foot back toe-off, opposite of1.
Frame6 weight onto right sole, left heel lifts, left knee swings.
Frame7 right leg supports, left knee passes, left toe lifted.
Frame8 left lower leg reaches forward toward the next frame1 contact.
Only subtle torso bob, natural hip/shoulder opposition, feet at correct floor plane. In-place cycle with no camera drift; frame8 flows back to1 without duplicate frame or frozen pause. Painted cloth responds slightly to stride, armor remains rigid.
Fine hand-painted2D fantasy sprite illustration, controlled brushwork, broad readable values, not a3D render or pixel mosaic. Sharp material details and readable faces consistent with reference. Identical figure size in all cells; walking poses do not shrink/grow or rotate to another view. Body roughly70percent of cell height with ample border for all limbs.
TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the exact figures. No haze, backdrop, floor, shadow, scenery, motion streaks, writing, frame numbers, labels, borders, weapons in hands or extra characters. This is a frame-by-frame walk animation sheet, not eight unrelated standing poses.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: EIGHT consecutive COMBAT WALK sprite frames. EXACT4columns by2rows, large landscape sheet. The reference is our APPROVED original dark-haired knight: exact same exposed readable face, dark wavy hair, navy split tabard, blue-steel brass-trimmed breastplate and segmented pauldrons, chainmail joints, brown diagonal strap/belt, leather-and-steel gloves, slim normal brown boots. Fine hand-painted2D tactical RPG sprite art, not3D. Full-body3/4 facing screen RIGHT at shallow18-degree camera, SAME camera/identity/costume/palette/light/body size in EVERY frame, no row-dependent turning toward profile. Restrained upper-left light. Transparent alpha outside exact figure/weapon silhouettes, no backdrop/haze/floor/shadow, grid lines, writing, labels, borders, effects, motion trails or extra objects. Equal cells, ordered left-to-right then next row. Body/feet/head/blade always uncropped with generous margins.
The selected combat reference image shows the starting guard: BOTH gloves on the SAME long sword grip, hands naturally projected FORWARD at upper-abdomen/lower-chest level, elbows softly bent. The straight rigid sword points diagonally up-right40-50degrees. Keep that guard while walking, no side-held vertical guard.
Eight-frame in-place natural walking loop, not8standing duplicates. Frame1 left forward contact/right back toe-off;2 transfer onto left sole/right knee swings;3 right knee passes supporting left;4 right leg reaches next contact;5 right forward contact/left back toe-off;6 transfer onto right sole/left knee swings;7 left knee passes supporting right;8 left leg reaches next contact and flows to1. Modest stride and knee bend, feet track forward under hips, no wide squat/bowed knees/high kicks. Hip/shoulder weight shift and very small bob. Longsword shape/length stay constant and BOTH hands remain firmly on the handle. Same front-and-side breastplate exposure in both rows; never rotate body to pure side view. Body about65percent cell height.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIXTEEN painted FULL-BODY ANIMATION KEYFRAMES in EXACT4columns x4rows. The reference is our APPROVED original dark-haired knight: exact same exposed readable face, dark wavy hair, navy split tabard, blue-steel brass-trimmed breastplate and segmented pauldrons, chainmail joints, brown diagonal strap/belt, leather-and-steel gloves, slim normal brown boots. Fine hand-painted2D tactical RPG sprite art, not3D. Full-body3/4 facing screen RIGHT at shallow18-degree camera, SAME camera/identity/costume/palette/light/body size in EVERY frame, no row-dependent turning toward profile. Restrained upper-left light. Transparent alpha outside exact figure/weapon silhouettes, no backdrop/haze/floor/shadow, grid lines, writing, labels, borders, effects, motion trails or extra objects. Equal cells, ordered left-to-right then next row. Body/feet/head/blade always uncropped with generous margins.
TWO ordered8-frame longsword actions. Same selected FORWARD two-hand guard as reference. Body at about50-55percent cell height so full horizontal sword reach fits; all poses SAME fixed scale and foot baseline, no zooming.
TOP TWO ROWS =8-frame full-body DIAGONAL SLASH:1 selected ready guard;2 shift weight back and turn hips/shoulders, hands rise;3 raised sword beside rear shoulder with coiled torso;4 start strong diagonal cut driven by hips/torso/shoulders;5 contact phase, torso uncoils and sword passes forward down across target line;6 natural follow-through below/at opposite hip, knees soften;7 decelerate and guide sword back;8 recover near starting forward guard. Both hands stay on the same long grip; blade never bends. This MUST be a real whole-body sword cut, not rotating a static arm at the wrist. No spin.
BOTTOM TWO ROWS =8-frame TWO-HANDED THRUST:1 ready guard;2 small coil/weight back and retract hands;3 align point forward;4 small balanced forward step as both arms extend;5 full forward thrust with torso engaged and blade nearly horizontal toward screen-right;6 decelerate, no hyperextension;7 retract arms/transfer weight back;8 return toward ready guard. Natural anatomy, restrained leg stance, proportional boots. All sword tips and feet within their own cells, no blood or target character.

ROW2 =4-frame HIT REACTION:1 combat ready,2 torso recoils/backward weight shift and head turns slightly,3 recover balance with planted feet and bent knees,4 return toward guard. No gore, injuries, impact effects or extra person.
ROWS3+4 =8-frame DEATH/FALL:1 ready guard;2 hit staggers torso;3 knees buckle naturally, hands lower;4 one knee touches floor and torso tilts;5 hip/hand reach ground;6 settle onto side, sword lowers alongside safely;7 nearly prone/side-lying body;8 final still fully collapsed body lying on the ground, sword nearby. Preserve same anatomy/clothing/face/size while height changes; DO NOT enlarge the fallen body to fill cell. Same projected floor plane. Full corpse and sword uncropped. No resurrection within these8frames, no blood, gore, smoke or magic. Death is non-looping.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Target: this8-frame4x2 neutral-walk animation sheet.
Repair the CAMERA DRIFT ONLY, especially bottom row: every knight must have the SAME FRONT THREE-QUARTER torso/head view as TOP-LEFT frame. Keep visible front breastplate, diagonal strap and front-and-side face exposure IDENTICAL between both rows; bottom row must NOT turn into a pure side-profile.
Preserve8cell layout, exact face/outfit/palette/body size, painted detail and chronological gait. Preserve distinct feet/legs/arm swing phases, but make them one coherent alternating left/right walk cycle with planted support foot and modest stride. Frame5 is opposite-leg contact from1,6 opposite transfer,7 opposite passing,8 opposite extension before returning to1.
No row-specific costume or boot changes, no pose duplication, no widened legs, knee bowing, hopping or high kicks. Full body/sheathed sword visible, free gloved hands, no weapon in hands.
Same cell size, fixed scale and camera throughout, actual transparent alpha, no floor/shadow/backdrop/haze, letters, numbers, grid lines, frames or effects. Change the angular inconsistency rather than the knight design.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIXTEEN painted full-body animation frames, EXACT4columns x4rows.
Reference1 is the approved knight combat guard A; reference2 is his neutral/rest appearance. Same original man/face/dark hair/navy split tabard/blue-steel brass-trimmed armor/chainmail joints/leather strap/belt/brown leather-steel gloves/proportional boots and constant3/4 facing screen RIGHT,18-degree camera. Same face and visible front breastplate in ALL rows; no pure side turning.

ROW2 =4frames subtle COMBAT IDLE: selected guard A with BOTH hands projecting FORWARD at upper-abdomen level, softly bent elbows, one long rigid sword diagonally up-right40-50degrees; very subtle breathing/weight shift, feet planted. No shoulder-side vertical guard.
ROW3 =4frames DRAW SWORD:1 relaxed/sheath stance;2 right glove takes hilt while left steadies scabbard;3 draw the sword forward clear of scabbard;4 both hands settle toward selected FORWARD combat guard.
ROW4 =4frames SHEATHE SWORD:1 combat guard;2 lower and orient point safely toward scabbard mouth;3 guide blade into sheath while left hand steadies it;4 relaxed hands-down neutral stance.
Sword remains ONE rigid straight object, no duplicates, no hand on sharp blade. Complete anatomy and consistent identity, natural soft knees, no wide squat or giant boots.
Exactly16 separate full figures in regular4x4cells. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside figures/weapon, no haze/backdrop/grid/text/labels/floor/shadow/effects, all heads/boots/sword tips uncropped.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR consecutive full-body dodge frames, EXACT2columns x2rows on transparent square sheet.
Use the reference approved knight identity/costume and FORWARD TWO-HANDED sword guard A unchanged: same adult face/dark hair/navy tabard/steel-brass armor/gloves/slim boots, fine PAINTED2D tactical RPG sprite art, full3/4 facing screen RIGHT,18degree camera, one constant scale/view/identity.
Frame1 ready forward two-hand guard. Frame2 small quick backward weight shift: rear foot accepts weight, hips move back, knees bend softly, torso leans just enough to evade a cut. Frame3 complete a short balanced backstep with upper body tucked, feet still narrow/tracking naturally and both hands controlling the rigid sword forward. Frame4 recover toward initial ready guard without hopping or a wide squat. This is a real articulated short evasive step, not sliding a still image. Rigid sword, no extra arms, no blade bending or wrist spin.
Exactly4 full figures in equal cells, each body about60percent cell height, full feet and entire sword safely inside margins. True transparent alpha outside exact figure, no backdrop/haze/floor/shadow/labels/grid/borders/effects/gore. All armor/face/body volume consistent.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: EIGHT DIRECTIONAL BASE DRAWINGS for animating the approved painted knight.
Use the reference for exact identity, face, dark hair, navy split tabard, fitted blue-steel brass-trim breastplate, small segmented pauldrons, chainmail joints, diagonal brown strap/belt, brown leather-steel gloves and ordinary proportional brown boots.
EXACT4columns x2rows, ONE complete unarmed knight per cell, SAME relaxed neutral stance in all cells, consistent scale,18degree shallow downward orthographic tactical camera, fixed shared soles baseline.
Directions in chronological turn around the man:
Top row1 FRONT facing viewer;2 FRONT-LEFT3/4 (nose screen-left);3 LEFT SIDE profile;4 BACK-LEFT3/4.
Bottom row5 BACK facing away;6 BACK-RIGHT3/4;7 RIGHT SIDE profile;8 FRONT-RIGHT3/4 (nose screen-right, approved view).

Legs straight/soft beneath hips, feet about hip width, no wide A-pose, squat, bent-out knees or huge boots. Head upright. No sword, scabbard, shield, bow or any other weapon/extra prop in these base drawings.
